name: Obrascón Huarte Lain, S.A.
summary: Obrascón Huarte Lain, S.A. operates as an infrastructure company primarily in the United States, Europe, and Latin America. The company operates through Construction, Industrial, and Other segments. The company carries civil engineering and building construction works for public and private customers. It is also involved in the design, construction, maintenance, and operation of oil and gas, renewable, mining and cement, solids engineering, and fire-fighting systems.
